title: Arrow's theorem via Fourier analysis
summary: This is a formalization in Lean 4 of Arrow's theorem for three-candidate elections as stated in Ryan O'Donnell's book "Analysis of Boolean Functions", Sec. 2.5, with a single voting rule applied to every pairwise election. The theorem states that every unanimous voting rule that always admits a Condorcet winner must be a dictatorship, i.e. there must exist a voter that alone determines the outcome.
